text:
Jules: Hey team — quick coordination for tomorrow's release train. I have slot 09:00-09:30 and plan to push infra-migrations and repackaging of the runtime image. Anyone want to swap?
Priya: I can take infra-migrations but only if I can move my feature branch deploy to 11:00. Is 11:00 free?
Maya: 11:00 looks open in the spreadsheet. @Jules you good with swapping to 11:00 for the runtime image?
Jules: Yeah I can shift to 11:00, that works. Priya, confirm you'll own the smoke checks for infra when you go at 09:00?
Priya: Confirming I'll own smoke at 09:00. I'll run the checklist and call out any DB migration flags. :thumbsup:
Omar: Heads-up — if migrations touch user-data, please include the extra backup step and set maintenance flag. Tag me if you need to run manual rollback.
Priya: Noted. I'll include the backup pre-step and post-verify. Plan for rollback: run `scripts/rollback.sh v2` and re-enable traffic via `proxyctl promote old` if needed.
Jules: For the runtime image at 11:00 I'll keep the canary at 10% for first 10 minutes then promote. Smoke owners: @Maya can you do smoke for runtime at 11:05?
Maya: Yep, I'll run the perf cursory checks and basic latency pings. I'll paste the smoke checklist results here.
deploy-bot: Deploy calendar entry created: https://calendar.company/rt/1774567890 (owner: Priya).
Priya: Quick CR ping — @Omar can you approve infra-migrations PR #842? Need it merged before 08:30 so I can run the pre-backup.
Omar: On it, I'll review now. If anything blocking I'll ping in this thread.
Jules: Small reminder: if anyone changes model quantization flags, keep model-variant fallback enabled (ticket #INF-312).
Maya: Copy that. Also adding short smoke script people can run locally:
Maya: ```
# smoke checks
curl -sS https://staging.api/health || exit 1
curl -sS https://staging.api/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}' | jq .output || exit 1
# latency check
wrk -t2 -c10 -d10s https://staging.api/generate
```
Priya: Perfect — I'll run that after migrations and paste outputs. ETA for smoke sign-off: ~09:12.
Jules: Great. Final ask: whoever owns rollback, please be ready from 09:00-09:45 for infra and 11:00-11:45 for runtime. If we need immediate rollback, call out `ROLLBACK NOW` in this thread and @Omar will execute.
Omar: Roger. I'll be on standby during both windows.
Jules: Thanks all — updating the release train sheet with the swaps now. :shipit:
